description: A Sallen Key lowpass filter for two signals, each polyphonic, sharing one cutoff and one resonance

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency, 16Hz to 16384Hz as a power of two
Attenuates the voltage at the Freq jack before it is added to the Freq knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets the resonance, 0 to 1; at 1 the damping is gone and the filter rings at the cutoff
Attenuates the voltage at the R jack before it is added to the R knob, 0 to 1

inputs.text: The first signal to be filtered, one per channel
The second signal to be filtered, one per channel
Modulates the cutoff, one octave per volt scaled by the Freq CV knob, and smoothed by the amount set in the menu
Modulates the resonance, a tenth per volt scaled by the R CV knob

outputs.text: The first signal with the frequencies above the cutoff taken out
The second signal with the frequencies above the cutoff taken out

notes: the two sides are separate and nothing is normalled between them, so a signal patched into InL alone leaves OutR silent
the cutoff is held between 2Hz and a third of the sample rate however far the knob and the jack push it
menu: Level Input — opens a slider marked Slew, which smooths the voltage at the Freq jack; the filter reacts sharply to a cutoff that jumps, and more slew keeps it quiet

inputs.2:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the Freq knob alone; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.3:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
